{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq for each patient
df_sorted = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])
df_dedup = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Compute the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
severe_count = df_dedup['severity'].eq('severe').sum()
total_patients = len(df_dedup)
fraction_severe = severe_count / total_patients

print(f"Severe count: {severe_count}")
print(f"Total patients: {total_patients}")
print(f"Fraction severe: {fraction_severe}")"}
